- RABBIT NIGHT LIGHT generated £2.2k revenue TW, the highest among all products tracked this week.
- WOOD BLACK BOARD ANT WHITE FINISH achieved £2.1k revenue TW, placing it as the second strongest performer.
- RED HARMONICA IN BOX led unit sales with 1,621 units sold TW, significantly outpacing MINI PAINT SET VINTAGE which sold 1,336 units TW.
- JUMBO BAG RED RETROSPOT recorded the most orders TW with 44 orders, while generating £1.6k revenue TW.
- SMALL ZINC HEART WALL ORGANISER showed exceptional growth of 11,787.1% WoW in revenue.
- CHRISTMAS LIGHTS 10 REINDEER demonstrated strong momentum with 9,372.1% revenue growth WoW.
- FELTCRAFT PRINCESS OLIVIA DOLL surged 23,496.0% YoY in revenue, the largest year-over-year increase among all products.
- BINGO SET grew 7,200.0% YoY in revenue, indicating substantial demand acceleration compared to the same week last year.
